The '''Scatalpen''' was a deadly predator from [[Aleen Minor/Legends|Aleen Minor]]. They hunted by slashing the stomachs of prey and causing them to trip on their entrails. The prey would then be killed brutally by the creature.

[[Ratts Tyerell/Legends|Ratts Tyerell]], a famous [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]], named his podracer the [[Titan 2150 rocket engine/Legends|Scatalpen]] for the dangerous creatures.
